description: Create a list: name it, add X handles of the investors/scouts/operators whose follows you trust, and optionally narrow it to sectors. It shows up as a tab in the app and can be queried with scope "list:<id>". feed "network" = a list over the whole Frontrun network instead of its members (needs a paid Pro plan to query). Members outside the network come back in not_polled: track them with frontrun_track to get their follows. FREE.

feed.description: "accounts" (default) = only the members' follows; "network" = the whole Frontrun network

handles.description: X handles to put in the list (without @, max 5,000)

max_followers.description: Only companies under this many X followers

min_tracking.description: Only companies at least this many of the list's accounts follow

sectors.description: Only companies in these sectors (e.g. ["AI", "Robotics"]). Empty = all

name: frontrun_list_create
